subject: Change in prospect travel — demo coverage / handoff options
raw_messages:
From: Samantha Chen <samantha@coretech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: CoreTech Events <events@coretech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change in site-visit dates — request to move demo

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads up: our executive team moved their visit up by a day for logistical reasons. They will now be onsite Tuesday 10/20 rather than Wed 10/21. The core buying group still wants the Redwood demo but needs it earlier.

Are you able to move our session to Tue 10/20 between 10:00–11:00 PT? If not, would Rafael be available to lead on-site? Alternatively, would a 30–45 min virtual run-through on Mon 10/19 morning work?

I'm attaching the updated travel itinerary (itinerary_coretech_10-20.pdf) and the updated attendee list in the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samantha Chen
Director, Product
CoreTech

--
Attachment: itinerary_coretech_10-20.pdf (application/pdf)


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chen <samantha@coretech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, CoreTech Events <events@coretech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Change in site-visit dates — request to move demo

Thanks for the heads up, Samantha — appreciate the quick notice.

I have a conflict that day (field event prep) and won't be able to be on-site at 10:00 PT. Options I can offer:

- Option A: Rafael leads the on-site demo Tue 10/20 10:00–11:00 PT (he's in-office and can bring the demo rig).
- Option B: Move to Tue 10/20 at 8:30–9:15 PT (I can make that earlier window and still join in person).
- Option C: Keep 10/21 but do a virtual 30–45 min walkthrough Mon 10/19 morning — good if execs prefer a condensed overview.

Rafael — can you confirm if Option A works and whether you need any site access or materials from CoreTech? Attaching the latest agenda (agenda_v2.pdf) for Rafael / events team.

If none of those work, we can do Rafael on-site and I can jump in remotely for Q&A.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: agenda_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Samantha Chen <samantha@coretech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Change in site-visit dates — request to move demo

Happy to lead on-site Tue 10/20 10:00–11:00 PT (Option A).

A couple quick asks:
- Can you confirm final attendee names and titles so I can tailor the deep-dive? (execs vs. engineers)
- Please share site access requirements (badging, parking, escort) and the room we'll be in. I've attached a placeholder site map (site_visit_map.png) — if you have an official floor plan that'd be great.
- I'll bring demo laptop + local models; if you want any specific datasets masked or redacted ahead of time let me know.

If Kimberly can do the earlier 8:30 window that's fine too, but I'll be on-site as primary.

Rafael
Field Solutions
Redwood Inference
